# Zapier SDK: examples and skill corpus

> Runnable examples and an installable agent skill for [`@zapier/zapier-sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zapier/zapier-sdk), Zapier's TypeScript SDK for programmatic access to 9,000+ app integrations. The SDK source lives on npm. This repo is the docs, verified examples, and skill manifest that AI agents grep at inference time.

Every action key in `examples/` is verified against Zapier's live catalog by CI, so agents that copy from this corpus land on valid calls the first time.

For the broader Zapier developer docs index (MCP, embedding, integration builder, White Label), see [docs.zapier.com/llms.txt](https://docs.zapier.com/llms.txt). The canonical SDK reference is at [docs.zapier.com/sdk](https://docs.zapier.com/sdk).

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/zapier/sdk/blob/main/README.md): install, authenticate, run your first action.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/zapier/sdk/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules of engagement for AI agents working in this repo (action-key verification, dynamic-input handling, escape hatches).
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/zapier/sdk/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): PR expectations and layout rules for adding examples.

## Skill and subagents

- [`skills/zapier-sdk/SKILL.md`](https://github.com/zapier/sdk/blob/main/skills/zapier-sdk/SKILL.md): the installable [agentskills.io](https://agentskills.io) manifest covering authentication, discovery, running actions, and escape hatches.
- [`skills/zapier-sdk/references/cli-commands.md`](https://github.com/zapier/sdk/blob/main/skills/zapier-sdk/references/cli-commands.md): full inventory of `zapier-sdk` CLI commands, generated from `zapier-sdk --help`.
- [`skills/zapier-workflows/SKILL.md`](https://github.com/zapier/sdk/blob/main/skills/zapier-workflows/SKILL.md): the installable manifest for building, testing, deploying, listing, and modifying durable Zapier workflows.
- [`agents/README.md`](https://github.com/zapier/sdk/blob/main/agents/README.md): optional Claude Code subagents that pair with the skill.
- [`agents/zapier-sdk-explorer.md`](https://github.com/zapier/sdk/blob/main/agents/zapier-sdk-explorer.md): read-only investigator that resolves exact app, action, and field IDs against the live Zapier catalog.

## Examples

The [`examples/`](https://github.com/zapier/sdk/tree/main/examples) directory is indexed three ways:

- [`examples/README.md`](https://github.com/zapier/sdk/blob/main/examples/README.md): corpus overview and conventions.
- [`examples/by-app/README.md`](https://github.com/zapier/sdk/blob/main/examples/by-app/README.md): plain single-action scripts, one authenticated call per file.
- [`examples/by-pattern/README.md`](https://github.com/zapier/sdk/blob/main/examples/by-pattern/README.md): end-to-end durable workflows grouped by shape (notify-on-event, data-sync, lead-routing, scheduled-report).
- [`examples/by-domain/README.md`](https://github.com/zapier/sdk/blob/main/examples/by-domain/README.md): symlink-only audience index (engineering, real-estate, and other verticals).

## Packages

- [`@zapier/zapier-sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zapier/zapier-sdk): the runtime SDK.
- [`@zapier/zapier-sdk-cli`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zapier/zapier-sdk-cli): the CLI companion.
- [`@zapier/zapier-sdk-core`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zapier/zapier-sdk-core): shared core types.

## Optional

- [Zapier MCP](https://github.com/zapier/zapier-mcp): the MCP-server alternative for tool-calling from Cursor, Claude Desktop, or Codex. Reach for it when the deliverable is ad-hoc tool use rather than shipped code.
- [docs.zapier.com/llms.txt](https://docs.zapier.com/llms.txt): broader Zapier developer-docs index.
- [zapier.com/sdk](https://zapier.com/sdk): product page and pricing.
